BiblicalUsage: Hadarezer is the Syrian king of Zobah whom David struck down as he went to recover his border at the Euphrates. The name is spelled Hadarezer in the KJV where the Hebrew text carries the same man under the spelling Hadadezer, and the two spellings name one king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hadarezer matters because God knows His people by name, and Hadarezer is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
